escena: SCENE (cinematic still, a dark modern creative studio at night): Nexa stands at the centre of the frame, framed from the waist up, looking straight into the lens with a calm, confident half-smile. The Spark HOVERS just above and slightly behind her right shoulder (the left side of the frame), close to her head and a little lower than it, looking at the camera too with happy LED eyes, one small hand resting lightly on her shoulder. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens; her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and only her eyes move. She wears the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. The Spark is copied EXACTLY from its reference image: the glossy white hovering sphere with navy visor, azure LED eyes and smile, sparkle antenna, tilted white orbit ring with its small sphere and three azure belly windows; it is about the size of her head, never larger, and floats above her waist. The Spark's own azure LEDs are a real light source that lights her face softly. A cool rim light from behind outlines both of them; light haze. No logos of any other brand, no readable text.
